about_the_game:
Your Source for Beautiful Email Backgrounds and Stationery.

Make every email special with Email Backgrounds & Stationery. Our app offers a vast collection of free, stunning HTML email backgrounds, stationery, themes, and templates designed to elevate your email messages. Whether you're expressing gratitude, sending a heartfelt invitation, or simply staying in touch, our backgrounds ensure your emails stand out in any inbox.

Compatible with Mac Mail, Gmail, Yahoo Mail, Hotmail, AOL, Outlook, Windows Mail, and other webmail clients, Email Backgrounds lets you effortlessly integrate style and personal touch into your everyday communications.

Start sending memorable emails that capture the essence of your message and leave a lasting impression.

Make every email a memorable one with Email Backgrounds! Download now and start creating beautiful emails today.

Features:

  • Enjoy seamless access across Windows, Mac OS Desktop, and more with a single purchase.

  • Access thousands of email backgrounds and stationery options across 25 categories.

  • Simply copy your selected background to the clipboard and paste it into your email client.

  • Choose from 80 unique handwriting fonts to craft your message.

  • Customize font color, size, and alignment (center, left, or right).

  • Save backgrounds for quick and easy future reference with the "My Favorites" feature.

  • Edit or update your email messages, even after sending, with the "My History" feature.

  • Share your email stationery easily via SMS or social media using a shareable link option.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or better
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Universal binary: supports Intel and Apple Silicon

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz dual-core processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or Any GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 64-bit systems
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or discrete graphics card
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports high-DPI displays.
